name: Redesignee
author: redesignee

sections.description:
Redesignee connects your WordPress site to a cloud library of premium web components. Whether you use Elementor or the Block Editor (Gutenberg), you can browse, customize, and insert widgets like Hero sections, Testimonials, and Pricing tables without writing code.

Features

  • Universal: Works in Elementor and Gutenberg.
  • Live Editor: Customize text, images, and colors visually.
  • Lightweight: Only loads the CSS/JS required for the widget.
  • Rich Text Support: Edit content easily with a built-in rich text editor.
  • Video Support: Easily embed YouTube videos or self-hosted video files.

3rd Party Service Disclaimer

This plugin relies on the Redesignee cloud service to function. It connects to the Redesignee API to fetch widget templates, library data, and assets.

  • This service is required to browse and import widgets.
  • An API Key (Free or Premium) is used to authenticate your request.
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party services to function.

  1. Google Web Fonts

    • Service: Google Web Fonts (API)
    • Usage: Used within the editor overlay to display font previews.
    • Data Sent: IP address and User-Agent are sent to Google to fetch font definitions.
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
    • Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/fonts/terms

  2. Redesignee Widget Library

    • Service: Redesignee (SaaS)
    • Usage: Connects to Redesignee servers to fetch dynamic widget code (HTML/CSS/JS) requested by the user.
    • Data Sent: Your website URL and IP address are processed to deliver the correct widget assets.
    • Privacy Policy: https://redesignee.com/privacy-policy
    • Terms of Service: https://redesignee.com/terms-of-service
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/redesignee directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Redesignee Settings in your admin dashboard to enter your API Key (optional for free widgets).
  4. Open a page in Elementor or Gutenberg and search for “Redesignee”.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Redesignee account?

You can use the free version of the plugin without an account. However, you will need to register for a Redesignee account to access premium widgets and features.

Does this work with any theme?

Yes, Redesignee widgets are built with standard HTML/CSS and work with any WordPress theme.

How do I customize the widgets?

For a no-code experience, you must use Elementor or the Gutenberg Block Editor. In these editors, our visual interface allows you to change text, colors, images, and styles instantly without writing code. If you use a different page builder, you can still insert the widgets, but you will need to edit the HTML and CSS code manually.

What types of widgets are available?

The library includes a wide range of professional web components, such as Hero sections, Testimonials, Sliders, Mega Menus, Feature grids, Call-to-Action banners, Galleries, and more.
